method: Insert/shelf and insert/faceplate checks shift the mating part 0.01 mm forward only during verification to separate intended contact.
AirPods stand-in has a 0.02 mm lift from the intended bottom contact; it is a nominal stadium approximation, not a scan of the real cased device.
Charging-path check uses a 20 mm long prism inset 0.2 mm from the opening; it does not model an actual USB-C elbow or cable bend.
OpenSCAD reports empty top-level objects with exit code 1; empty text without ERROR is the expected result.
scope: Limited CAD intersection checks; no slicer, real-device, strength or installed-fit certification.
